ideas.pitch: An AI-powered urban congestion and traffic incident prediction dashboard built for Ghaziabad traffic nodes, utilizing Poisson regression and rolling backtests to optimize local municipal bus routes and emergency response paths.
ideas.title: UrbanPulse IPEC: Smart Campus & City Traffic Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Smart Cities & Urban Innovation track by providing a tangible, locally relevant municipal tool with calibrated prediction intervals, matching patterns from top-tier forecasting wins.

ideas.pitch: A localized security telemetry monitoring agent that ingests campus IoT sensor and server logs to surface prioritized threat vectors using explainable machine learning models.
ideas.title: CampusGuard AI: Automated Smart City Cyber Threat & Incident Correlation Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the Cybersecurity track requirements by implementing clear risk scoring and automated compliance logging inspired by award-winning AML and security platforms.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled resource monitoring network that securely records decentralized solar micro-grid generation and campus water consumption onto an immutable ledger with automated micropayment settlements.
ideas.title: EcoGrid IoT: Decentralized Smart City Energy & Water Metering Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Internet of Things (IoT) hardware simulation with Web3 & Blockchain mechanics, giving judges in both tracks a dual-application architecture.

ideas.pitch: A localized, multi-lingual AI intake assistant tailored for tier-2 city clinics in India that automates patient onboarding, triage, and trust-building summaries using the Gemini API.
ideas.title: MediTrust IPEC: Generative AI Patient Trust & Regional Clinic Acquisition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven patterns from high-impact healthcare and trust engine wins by directly addressing immediate operational pain points for community medical practices.

ideas.pitch: An AR-powered spatial orientation web app built for complex university campuses that overlays dynamic safety routes, emergency exits, and facility maps via browser-based computer vision.
ideas.title: CampusAR Nav: Immersive AR Indoor Navigation and Disaster Evacuation Guide
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the AR/VR & Immersive Technologies track with a concrete safety use case that campus organizers and judges can immediately test in the venue.
